speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: Next, on the Property Tax Act 1960, or PTA, there are two groups of amendments.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: This is in line with the respective Comptrollers' powers to admit late objections under other tax legislation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: These amendments are aligned with those already made under the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2022 to the Income Tax Board of Review and the Goods and Services Tax Board of Review.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: The amendments also move various Act-level procedural provisions to subsidiary legislation and clarify the Minister's regulation-making powers on VRB appeals, as well as case management powers of the VRB and the Chairperson.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: In deciding whether or not to convene a one-member coram, the Chairperson will consider the parties' submissions, as well as the facts and circumstances of the case.

speaker: The Chairman
text: The citation year "2023" will be changed to "2024", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.
